cards.title: PopPK Data Requirements and Sampling Strategy
cards.claim: Population PK analysis requires PK data of sufficient quantity and quality from subjects representing the indicated population. Sampling schedules should be optimized to estimate parameters and covariate effects with defined precision. For time-varying covariates or between-occasion variability, multiple samples per individual at more than one occasion are required.
conditions: Data must represent the target population.
Sampling around Tmax is required if Cmax is used for E-R analysis.
Missing data handling must be justified (e.g., sensitivity analysis).
required_inputs: Rich or sparse PK sampling data.
limitations: Stand-alone studies may miss interactions or lack target population representation.
High shrinkage (>20-30%) reduces reliability of EBEs for E-R analysis.
cards.downstream_use: Designing sampling schemes for clinical trials; assessing data adequacy for model building.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
